snippet.title: HypurrX 2025 March Development Update
snippet.description:
𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 𝗡𝗲𝘄𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲
..already hurtling through 2025 and we are delighted to bring you some long awaited news of our progress on HypurrX.

𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
Check out our development update video giving a glimpse of the action and chaos we have been working on.

• Our pilot profile screen is coming together allowing you to sign-up your furry friend to join M.E.O.W
• The gameplay HUD now features a direct link to your pilot's cam comm link to keep you better connected throughout the action.
• The points scoring system is coming together as we begin ramping up the challenges for tournament play.
• Your flight suit has been tailored specifically to get you back in the action as you will freefall back into your ship and continue the mission! Make the most of your 9 Lives! ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ


𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁 𝗔𝗿𝘁 𝗗𝗿𝗼𝗽𝘀!
Our first official concept art pack is dropping shortly where you can see some of the design and ideas going into the game hot off the production line.

𝗢𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗡𝗲𝘄𝘀
We were honoured to present our Indie Dev Story for this months MEE Games Indie Dev Meetup and hope to share more of our journey as our development journey goes on.

Give us your feedback and thoughts in our community channels and please help our indie project by liking and sharing the content.
More coming soon! 

#hypurrx #spacecatshootergame #shmup #stg #catgame #bukostudios #bullethell #GameDevelopment #indiegame #indiegamedev
